workloads.name: filter
workloads.sql: SELECT i FROM t WHERE i%2=0

workloads.name: point

workloads.name: correlated_exists
workloads.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM t WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM u WHERE u.i=t.i%64)

workloads.name: recursive_linear
workloads.sql: WITH RECURSIVE r(i) AS (SELECT 0::BIGINT UNION ALL SELECT i+1 FROM r WHERE i<999) SELECT count(*),sum(i) FROM r

workloads.name: recursive_cycle
workloads.sql: WITH RECURSIVE r(i) AS (SELECT 0::BIGINT UNION SELECT (i+1)%257 FROM r) SELECT i FROM r

workloads.name: recursive_correlated
workloads.sql: SELECT (WITH RECURSIVE r(i) AS (SELECT j UNION ALL SELECT i+1 FROM r WHERE i<j+8) SELECT sum(i) FROM r) FROM range(16) x(j)

scope: Warm in-memory prepared-query execution and complete result validation in embedded APIs, serial C++ and Rust. Setup/preparation/process startup precede timing. This measures these cases only; it does not cover cold I/O, commit latency, concurrency, other APIs/tooling or all C++ workloads. Every ratio above 1 fails; noise is not treated as acceptance or compensated by speedups.
